view.subline: {chief} · Dawn Academy experts, {total} in the game

toolbar.emptyDescription: Change the search or the filters to see more experts.
toolbar.status: Showing {shown} of {total}. Goals are read only here and are set in Plan. At a level divisible by 10 the bonus of the level before counts until the expert is advanced. Every change saves at once.
toolbar.lockedNote: {count} locked until a later server day.

toast.notRecruitedMessage: The levels stay saved and switch back on with Recruited.

card.bonusOwnLevel: Level {level} is not a multiple of 10, so its own bonus counts.
card.bonusAdvanced: Level {level} is advanced, so its own bonus counts.
card.bonusNotAdvanced: Level {level} is not advanced, so the level {counted} bonus counts.
card.notRecruitedHint: Not recruited. Recruit this expert in Tundra Trek, then switch Recruited on.
card.sigilsHint: The same count as the sigil on the Resources page.
card.skillTotal: Level {next} needs a total skill level of {total}. Now {have}.

filtersFlyout.title: Filters
filtersFlyout.description: Narrow the list of experts and pick the order.

plan.title: Plan experts
plan.description: Books of Knowledge, sigils, skill EXP and affinity points for affinity and skill goals.
plan.exportNothing: The plan needs no books or sigils to export.
plan.noExperts: No experts in the plan yet. Add a recruited expert to set its goals.

add.title: Add an expert
add.allIn: Every recruited expert is in the plan.
add.noneRecruited: Recruit an expert on the page to plan it.

stock.sigils: The plan needs {total} sigils. Your expert sigils cover {own} of them, so {common} must come from Common Expert Sigils. Each expert sigil you hold only counts for that expert.
stock.books: The plan needs {amount} Books of Knowledge for the skill levels.
stock.affinity: The plan needs {needed} affinity points. The affinity gifts on the Resources page and the points on the expert cards cover {held}, so {left} are still to get.
stock.learning: The plan needs {exp} skill EXP. Your skills hold {held}, so {left} must come from learning speedups. One minute of learning gives {rate} EXP, so that is {minutes} minutes.

byExpert.title: By expert
byExpert.sigils: Sigils: {needed} needed, {own} covered by your {name} sigil, {common} to come from Common Expert Sigils
byExpert.affinity: Affinity: {needed} needed, {held} covered, {left} still to get
byExpert.exp: Skill EXP: {needed} needed, {held} available, {left} still to get

result.title: Result
result.empty: Add an expert and raise a goal to see the result.

learning.title: Learning
learning.note: One skill learns at a time. Finish adds the EXP to that skill.
learning.idle: Nothing is learning. Start a session to add EXP to a skill.
learning.slotLabel: Learning, one session at a time
learning.manageFinishText: Finish upgrade adds the EXP of the session to the skill, frees the learning queue and adds the session to your History. At zero time left the card says Ready to finish. Nothing finishes by itself, because you may have used speedups.

flyout.title: Start learning
flyout.description: Mark a learning session as running for an expert skill
flyout.sessionHint: A session earns 60 EXP for each minute. The sessions are the ones of the game.
flyout.tooMuch: The skill needs only {room} more EXP, so the session is shortened to {time}.
flyout.startedHint: Use Already started when the session is running in the game. Enter the time it shows.
flyout.nothingToLearn: No skill can learn right now. Recruit an expert and unlock a skill that is not at its top level.
flyout.busy: A session is already running. Finish or cancel it in Manage first.

finished.title: {what} learned
finished.message: The EXP was added to the skill and to History.

cancelled.title: {what} canceled
cancelled.message: The skill keeps the EXP it had.
